name: font-japanese
title: Font: Zen Kaku Gothic New
description: Japanese reading face (kana and kanji, SIL OFL) for furigana, vertical text and original-language bubbles. Sets --font-manga-jp, which base adds as the Japanese fallback of every text face. Optional: not installed by base; without it the system's Japanese font is used.

meta.tagline: A Japanese reading face for furigana and vertical text.
